claims.statement: Tom Allen and Jim Coyne gave a sparring exhibition in Rochester, New York, on the night of September 18, 1869.
claims.excerpt:
Last night Tom Allen
and Jim Coyne gave a sparring Exhibition in
Rochester, New York.

claims.statement: Tom Allen's party was expected to be joined by Jem Mace and to reach St. Louis on Saturday, September 25, 1869.
claims.excerpt:
